name: gr-efka
description: Greek e-EFKA social insurance contributions of the self-employed for 2026: freelancers (ελεύθεροι επαγγελματίες), the self-employed (αυτοαπασχολούμενοι) and farmers insured under the former OGA. Covers the six insurance categories and their 2026 monthly amounts under e-EFKA circular 6/2026 (main pension, health in cash and in kind), the special category for the first five years of insurance, the EUR 10 unemployment (DYPA, former OAED) charge, the three supplementary and three lump-sum categories, farmers' six categories, the annual category choice, parallel employment, the payment deadline (last working day of the following month), late payment and KEAO, and how paid contributions reduce business profit. Trigger on: EFKA contributions, εισφορές μη μισθωτών 2026, ασφαλιστική κατηγορία, ειδική κατηγορία νέων, ελεύθερος επαγγελματίας ΕΦΚΑ, Greek freelancer social security. Out of scope: gr-employee-contributions (employees and employers), gr-income-tax (the tax computation), gr-cross-bord
